display_title: Stepping Out of the Shower to Find a Mysterious Beauty in My Bed
description:
The biggest joy in Jung-wook's life is a motel date with his girlfriend!
But after showering and returning to the motel bed, he finds not his girlfriend, but an older woman lying there...!?
